## Methods notes

* Why these tests: DeLong compares two correlated ROC AUCs on the same recordings; McNemar compares paired binary decisions. Neither assumes normality of the metric across recordings.
* Pseudo-replication: confidence intervals resample independent units (sentence groups or speakers), not windows or duplicated files.
* Multiple comparisons: Holm correction within each protocol × test set family.
